name: terrain-vegetation

interface.placement: Build once under the locked reference camera; sample final world X/Z ground height and bury roots .025 below it. Fallback soil height .035.

ground_floor.usage: After building ground, call applyForestFloor(groundGroup, {...ctx, heightAt, surfaceAt}) to blend footprints into existing continuous-carved-ground vertex colors. Vegetation build does not call this. No meshes are added.

integration_notes: Build ground first and pass its heightAt and surfaceAt to vegetation build(ctx).
Import the three child forests only through vegetation.js to avoid duplicate trees.
Apply consolidated forest-floor material suggestions to terrain; final evidence uses the optional adapter.
Belt materials are cloned and harmonized here; belt width/height scales 1.06/1.03 and foreground .92/1.045 preserve root layout.
Final preview used current terrain-mountain/mountain.js as read-only context; mountain is not part of this component. Parent must use its final delivered mountain.
Keep reference-camera context fixed while constructing; rotate the render camera afterward for inspection.
Global lighting still yields softer/shorter shadows than the reference and is for the scene parent to reconcile.
remaining_visual_approximations: Individual crown outlines and small tree-spacing variations
Contextual architecture, mountain and ground details are independently owned
